nfd859280ff.headline: StanChart picks former JPMorgan executive as next India head
nfd859280ff.summary: Standard Chartered has nominated former JPMorgan India chief P.D. Singh to be its next India and South Asia CEO, according to two sources. The appointment fills a senior role in one of the bank's key markets.
nfd859280ff.why: Standard Chartered is a London-listed bank with major operations in Asia and Africa, and its India business is a significant part of its franchise.

nc3a00fa15d.headline: Karácsony: Budapest's Real Problem is 'No Money'
nc3a00fa15d.summary: Budapest mayor Gergely Karácsony told a conference that the capital's real problem is that the municipality has no money.
nc3a00fa15d.why: Municipal budgets affect city infrastructure spending and municipal bond issuance, which matter to local construction and debt investors.

n73786f6fcf.headline: Brazil's Lula rushed to hospital for brain surgery
n73786f6fcf.summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has undergone surgery to drain a bleed in his brain, linked to an earlier condition.
n73786f6fcf.why: Changes in the health or availability of a head of state can affect political stability and investor expectations for Brazil's policy agenda.

n20bc54aa7a.headline: Serbia lifts nuclear power ban
n20bc54aa7a.summary: Serbia has lifted a moratorium on nuclear power, as the country seeks energy independence and an end to fossil fuel use. The move reverses a long-standing ban.
n20bc54aa7a.why: Nuclear policy shapes long-term power supply, utility investment and energy-import dependence, all of which matter to energy investors and project developers.

nc2238471cb.headline: Bursa Malaysia ends lower in muted trading ahead of US inflation print
nc2238471cb.summary: Bursa Malaysia ended lower in thin trading, with volume below three billion shares, after weak Wall Street performance. Investors are cautious ahead of US inflation data that will influence the December 18 rate decision.
nc2238471cb.why: Bursa Malaysia is the national stock exchange of Malaysia, and its index tracks the country's largest listed companies.

n18be962f9d.headline: EQT :  Early Results and Upsizing of EQM Midstream Partners, LP’s Tender Offer and Consent Solicitation for Certain of its Senior Notes Form 8 K
n18be962f9d.summary: EQT Corporation announced early results and an upsizing of the tender offer and consent solicitation for certain senior notes of EQM Midstream Partners, LP.
n18be962f9d.why: EQT is a Pittsburgh-based natural gas producer, and debt management by its midstream affiliate affects its financing costs.

n99652f73b1.headline: Talks to avoid government shutdown are underway
n99652f73b1.summary: Talks to avoid a government shutdown are underway in Washington. The year for lawmakers is winding down, and the funding deadline is next Friday.
n99652f73b1.why: A US government shutdown can delay federal data releases and spending, and it often weighs on sentiment in US equity and Treasury markets.

nb214393161.headline: DLF Camellias
nb214393161.summary: A Rs 190-crore deal has set a new record for price per square foot in India's luxury real estate market. Propequity CEO Samir Jasuja said it is the highest-ever price for a high-rise apartment in India.
nb214393161.why: Luxury residential prices are a gauge of high-end housing demand, relevant to developers, lenders and real estate investors in India.

nd4accddc44.headline: Gov't to Launch HUF 200 bln Housing Development Scheme
nd4accddc44.summary: Hungary's National Economy Minister Márton Nagy announced a HUF 200 billion capital program starting in March 2025 to support construction of dormitories, rental flats and homes. The report cites state news wire MTI.
nd4accddc44.why: Large state-backed construction programmes affect construction demand, building materials suppliers and the government's fiscal spending.

nefdc8f16e5.headline: Fitch Revises Hungary's Outlook to 'Stable', Affirms Debt Grade
nefdc8f16e5.summary: Fitch revised Hungary's outlook to 'stable' from 'negative' and affirmed its debt grade at 'BBB'. The agency cited a reduction in macroeconomic imbalances.
nefdc8f16e5.why: Fitch is one of the three major credit rating agencies, and sovereign ratings influence government borrowing costs and investor demand for national bonds. A change in outlook signals the agency's view of medium-term risk.

n3425da4adf.headline: Second audit finds more consent breaches at Macraes mine
n3425da4adf.summary: A second audit has found more consent breaches at the Macraes mine in New Zealand. The mine is operated under resource consents issued by the regulator.
n3425da4adf.why: The Macraes mine in Otago is an operating gold mine run by OceanaGold. Repeated consent breaches can lead to regulatory enforcement, compliance costs and operational restrictions.

n120de12f0a.headline: Argentina’s Milei marks one year in office. Here's how his shock measures are reshaping the economy
n120de12f0a.summary: Argentine President Javier Milei marked one year in office, with his shock economic measures reshaping the economy, according to an AP report.
n120de12f0a.why: Argentina's policy shifts under Milei affect inflation, the peso and investor confidence in the country's assets.

n7ab2b2dffa.headline: Tax Reform Bills: FG raises tax exemption threshold for SMEs to N50m
n7ab2b2dffa.summary: The federal government announced an increase in the tax exemption threshold for small and medium enterprises from N25 million to N50 million under tax reform bills.
n7ab2b2dffa.why: Tax thresholds determine which small and medium businesses pay corporate income tax, affecting their cash flow, growth and the wider Nigerian business environment.

n5434e11315.headline: More than 5 billion people will be flying next year
n5434e11315.summary: The global airline industry is expected to generate $1 trillion in revenue in 2025, with more than 5 billion people projected to fly, according to IATA.
n5434e11315.why: IATA is the airline industry's trade body, and its forecasts are closely watched for demand and profitability across global aviation.

nd34c7d212f.headline: BYD Sealion 6, Sealion 7 get a baby brother with electric power
nd34c7d212f.summary: BYD is adding another electric model to its lineup, a new variant alongside the Sealion 6 and Sealion 7, though the mid-sized model's details remain unclear.
nd34c7d212f.why: BYD is one of China's largest electric vehicle makers and a leading global competitor in battery electric cars.

nc9e067b97b.headline: Morning Bid: Dollar reasserts strength, China fillip fades
nc9e067b97b.summary: The dollar has regained momentum, helped by a rise in U.S. Treasury yields, ahead of a wave of overseas interest rate cuts this week. China's effect on the currency is fading.
nc9e067b97b.why: The U.S. dollar is the main reserve and trade currency, so its moves affect global commodity prices, emerging-market debt and multinational earnings.
nc9e067b97b.why_moved: A rise in U.S. Treasury yields has lifted the dollar. Traders are also positioning ahead of a wave of overseas interest rate cuts this week.

n43d1bfd249.headline: Generali buys Palazzo Carciotti for EUR13.2 million
n43d1bfd249.summary: Generali has acquired Palazzo Carciotti in Trieste for EUR13.2 million, according to a report in Milano Finanza. The neoclassical building is the historic site of the insurer's foundation in 1831.
n43d1bfd249.why: Generali is one of Europe's largest insurers, and its property purchases reflect how it allocates capital across real estate assets.

n09f3be1095.headline: RMAFC denies opposing tax reform bills
n09f3be1095.summary: Nigeria's Revenue Mobilisation Allocation and Fiscal Commission has denied reports that it opposed President Bola Tinubu's proposed tax reform bills.
n09f3be1095.why: Nigeria's tax reform bills determine how revenue is raised and shared among federal and state governments, which affects fiscal policy and investor views on the country's public finances.

n0f795e664c.headline: Mediobanca raises EUR484 million for co-investment
n0f795e664c.summary: Mediobanca Private Banking has raised EUR484.0 million for a real estate co-investment programme developed with Mediobanca SGR and UBS Asset Management.
n0f795e664c.why: Mediobanca is an Italian investment bank and wealth manager, and its private banking fundraising reflects demand for alternative real estate investments among wealthy clients.

impacts.why: The bank's private banking division raised the capital for the co-investment programme.

n13eb9fe13b.headline: Vail Resorts’ Epic Pass sales down for winter 2024-25 says earnings report
n13eb9fe13b.summary: Vail Resorts reported that Epic Pass sales fell 2% for the 2024-25 winter season. Higher pass prices lifted the company's sales revenue by $5 more per pass.
n13eb9fe13b.why: Vail Resorts operates ski resorts and sells season passes, which are a key source of recurring revenue for the company.

impacts.name: Vail Resorts
impacts.why: Fewer pass units sold were offset by higher pricing, so pass revenue effects are mixed.

nc6d4227323.headline: Brazil inflation soars to 14-month high - Invezz
nc6d4227323.summary: Brazil's inflation rate climbed to its highest level in 14 months, according to the report. The figure is a key input for the central bank's interest-rate decisions.
nc6d4227323.why: Inflation trends shape central-bank rate policy, which affects bond yields, borrowing costs and currency values in Latin America's largest economy.

n05f4b72a81.headline: EFG Hermes completes advisory on Talabat, Lulu IPOs
n05f4b72a81.summary: EFG Hermes completed its advisory role on the Talabat and Lulu initial public offerings. The share sales bring its total GCC IPO count to nine this year.
n05f4b72a81.why: EFG Hermes is an investment bank active in Gulf capital markets, and IPO advisory mandates indicate deal flow and capital raising in the region.

n0f92977aa0.headline: Edinburgh Airport Christmas flights threatened as strike announced over pay row
n0f92977aa0.summary: Fuel tanker drivers employed by North Air have announced a 19-day strike starting on December 18 over a pay dispute. The strike threatens Christmas flights from Edinburgh Airport.
n0f92977aa0.why: Edinburgh Airport is a major Scottish gateway, and fuel supply disruptions can curtail airline operations and travel revenue.

n0c6fcb43cf.headline: Birmingham City Council and unions agree ‘historic outcome’ to equal pay claim
n0c6fcb43cf.summary: Birmingham City Council and unions have agreed what the council leader called a historic outcome to an equal pay claim, marking a new era of industrial relations.
n0c6fcb43cf.why: Equal pay settlements can carry large costs for local authorities and reflect wider labour-relations and public-finance pressures in the UK.

n8315166c50.headline: Biden administration races to secure a ceasefire in Gaza with Trump’s backing
n8315166c50.summary: The Biden White House is working with incoming Trump administration officials to reach a ceasefire and hostage deal to halt the war in Gaza between Israel and Hamas.
n8315166c50.why: The Gaza conflict affects energy and shipping risk in the Middle East and shapes geopolitical risk premiums that investors monitor across regional markets.

nce53db2791.headline: Japan launches US$670 million semiconductor subsidy scheme
nce53db2791.summary: The Japanese government is providing subsidies for domestic production in semiconductors, advanced electronic components and batteries. The aim is to strengthen economic security and supply chains.
nce53db2791.why: Government subsidies for chipmaking shape where semiconductor capacity is built, affecting chipmakers, equipment suppliers and supply chains.

na51ab32414.headline: France's Macron to host party leaders in quest for new govt
na51ab32414.summary: French party leaders will meet at the Elysee Palace on Tuesday afternoon to chart a route toward a new government. The talks follow the recent departure of Prime Minister Michel Barnier.
na51ab32414.why: Political instability in France affects government budgets, eurozone bond spreads and investor confidence in the euro area's second-largest economy.

n7d233d6cb3.headline: French power supply disrupted by striking workers
n7d233d6cb3.summary: A strike by workers at nuclear and hydro facilities operated by state-owned EDF disrupted some 2.5 gigawatts of French power production on Tuesday, according to company data.
n7d233d6cb3.why: EDF is France's state-owned power giant and the operator of most of the country's nuclear fleet, so its output affects French and European electricity supply and prices.

n4cc8b18a56.headline: LexisNexis Risk Solutions Announces Definitive Agreement to Acquire IDVerse
n4cc8b18a56.summary: LexisNexis Risk Solutions, part of RELX, has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire IDVerse, a provider of AI-powered automated document verification. The announcement was made via a press release.
n4cc8b18a56.why: RELX is a global information and analytics group, and LexisNexis Risk Solutions sells identity and risk-verification tools to businesses, so bolt-on deals reshape its product offering.

nfe6f1502ac.headline: Australia central bank leaves door open to February rate cut
nfe6f1502ac.summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia governor said on Tuesday that a rate cut as early as February remains possible. The bank would need to see more economic data first.
nfe6f1502ac.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate, which drives borrowing costs, the Australian dollar and asset valuations.
nfe6f1502ac.why_moved: The central bank left open the possibility of a February rate cut, pending incoming economic data.

nc31b2d4265.headline: Birmingham City Council and unions agree ‘historic outcome’ to equal pay claim
nc31b2d4265.summary: Birmingham City Council and unions have reached what the council leader called a historic outcome to an equal pay claim. The agreement is intended to start a new era of industrial relations.
nc31b2d4265.why: Large equal pay settlements carry significant costs for public employers and shape local labour relations.

n9e9905a770.headline: Springfield buoyant amid Budget housing funding and return of buyer confidence
n9e9905a770.summary: Springfield Properties said it remains confident in meeting market expectations for full-year 2025, citing an improvement in private housing reservation rates. Its first-half trading update covers the period to 30 November.
n9e9905a770.why: Springfield Properties is a Scottish housebuilder, so its reservation rates and trading updates signal conditions in the UK housing market.

n91a57e2428.headline: Indian rupee hits record low, bonds rise as change of guard at India’s central bank spurs rate cut bets
n91a57e2428.summary: The rupee hit a record low and Indian bonds rose after a change of governor at the Reserve Bank of India. Economists say the exit could add a dovish tilt to the MPC.
n91a57e2428.why: The Reserve Bank of India sets the country's policy rate and manages the rupee, so its leadership and rate expectations drive bond yields and currency moves.

impacts.name: Indian rupee
impacts.why: A record low for the rupee against the dollar is directly reported in the input.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n91a57e2428.why_moved: Economists say the governor's exit could add a dovish tilt to the monetary policy committee, which raised expectations of rate cuts and lifted bonds.

nfc83497bde.headline: China’s Xi warns ‘no winners’ in trade war with US
nfc83497bde.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping warned there would be no winners in a trade war with the US. Trump has pledged to impose even higher tariffs on China after taking office on January 20.
nfc83497bde.why: Tariffs and trade restrictions between the world's two largest economies affect global supply chains, corporate earnings and trade-exposed markets.

n6f9b5a4664.headline: CACEIS obtains Digital Asset Provider status across Europe
n6f9b5a4664.summary: CACEIS has received Digital Asset Provider status across Europe. It has also obtained Virtual Asset Provider status in Spain and Luxembourg.
n6f9b5a4664.why: CACEIS is a French custody and fund-services provider, and regulatory licences determine which digital-asset services it can offer institutional clients.

n15874fbc0d.headline: Coffee prices at record high after bad weather
n15874fbc0d.summary: Coffee prices have reached a record high as crops were hit by drought and heavy rainfall. Consumers are set to face higher prices.
n15874fbc0d.why: Coffee is a globally traded agricultural commodity, and weather-driven crop losses directly affect its futures prices and retail costs.

n8a10cced04.headline: Colombo shipyard seeks new investors after Onomichi exits
n8a10cced04.summary: The Colombo shipyard is seeking new investors after Japan's Onomichi exited the venture. Its board said it is confident it can steer the yard out of troubled waters after a significant loss in 2023.
n8a10cced04.why: Colombo Dockyard is Sri Lanka's largest shipbuilding and repair yard, and its funding situation reflects the country's wider financial strain.

ne9a93fd4e9.headline: Early Results and Upsizing of EQM Midstream Partners, LP
ne9a93fd4e9.summary: EQT Corporation announced early results and an upsizing of its offer related to EQM Midstream Partners, LP. The company is a subsidiary of EQT Corporation.
ne9a93fd4e9.why: EQT is a large US natural gas producer, and midstream pipeline units like EQM are central to moving its output to market.

ncc348b7397.headline: German Leader Scholz Backs Lower Grocery Taxes as Election Nears
ncc348b7397.summary: German Chancellor Olaf Scholz has proposed reducing value-added tax on basic groceries to help low-income households cope with persistently high inflation. The proposal comes as the election approaches.
ncc348b7397.why: Changes to value-added tax affect consumer prices, household spending and government revenue in Europe's largest economy.

n99ed02a7d8.headline: Riot Platforms :  Announces Pricing of Offering of 0.75% Convertible Senior Notes Form 8 K
n99ed02a7d8.summary: Riot Platforms announced the pricing of an offering of 0.75% convertible senior notes with $525 million aggregate principal amount, according to a company filing.
n99ed02a7d8.why: Riot Platforms is a bitcoin mining company. Convertible notes are a debt instrument that can be converted into equity, and they are used to fund growth.

nd1753906ce.headline: Shares at PSX snap winning streak as KSE-100 index plunges 1,000 points
nd1753906ce.summary: Shares on the Pakistan Stock Exchange snapped a winning streak as the KSE-100 index fell 1,000 points. Analysts cited profit-taking over political noise and pressure on the banking sector.
nd1753906ce.why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index of the Pakistan Stock Exchange, tracking the country's largest listed companies. Banks are a major weight in the index and are sensitive to domestic policy and political developments.
nd1753906ce.why_moved: Analysts attributed the decline to profit-taking after a winning streak and to political noise, according to the report.

n2ef69a49fa.headline: GameStop Corp. Q3 Earnings Summary
n2ef69a49fa.summary: GameStop reported third-quarter earnings of $17.4 million, compared with a loss of $3.1 million a year earlier. Earnings per share were $0.04 in the quarter.
n2ef69a49fa.why: GameStop is a US video game and collectibles retailer that is widely followed for its high retail-investor interest. Its quarterly results are a key indicator of its turnaround progress.

impacts.name: GameStop
impacts.why: Reported third-quarter earnings swung to a profit from a year-earlier loss.

n7f05d06ad4.headline: China policy talk lifts stocks but bonds balk
n7f05d06ad4.summary: Chinese equities rose on the authorities' latest vague promise of support for the sputtering economy, while bond markets did not follow the rally.
n7f05d06ad4.why: China's stock and bond markets are closely watched by global investors as gauges of the economy's health and of policy support. Equity and bond moves can diverge when investors doubt policy follow-through.
n7f05d06ad4.why_moved: Investors reacted to the government's vague pledge of support for the economy, boosting stocks, while bond investors appeared unconvinced.

n4981a768a3.headline: The automotive giant will establish a battery factory with a $4 billion investment.
n4981a768a3.summary: Stellantis and Chinese battery maker CATL plan a $4.3 billion factory in Zaragoza, Spain, to produce electric vehicle batteries, with production targeted by the end of 2026.
n4981a768a3.why: Stellantis is a global automaker and CATL is the world's largest EV battery maker, so their joint plant affects European EV supply chains and investment.

impacts.name: Stellantis
impacts.why: The company is investing $4.3 billion in a battery plant in Spain with CATL.

n5f0f2da57a.headline: Hyatt Shares Plans for New Luxury and Lifestyle Brands
n5f0f2da57a.summary: Hyatt detailed plans for over 50 luxury and lifestyle hotels to open worldwide by 2026 and created a new Lifestyle group led by Amar Lalvani.
n5f0f2da57a.why: Hyatt Hotels is a major global hotel operator, and its pipeline of openings signals future fee-based revenue growth from its brands.

n8ff2ed3dbf.headline: Poland Calls on Germany to Show Leadership on Defense Spending
n8ff2ed3dbf.summary: A senior Polish defence official said Germany should step up defence spending to set an example for the EU. Doubts are growing about US military support for Ukraine.
n8ff2ed3dbf.why: Defence budgets shape European fiscal priorities and industrial orders, and Germany is the EU's largest economy.

nef8fdafcea.headline: Revenues at Mercedes Benz Irish distributor surge by €50m
nef8fdafcea.summary: Revenues at the family-owned group distributing Mercedes-Benz cars in Ireland rose by €50 million last year. Pre-tax profits declined 5.5% to €24.92 million.
nef8fdafcea.why: Car distributors sell vehicles and parts for a manufacturer in a given market, and their results reflect regional car demand and margins.

n401e22ec21.headline: China launches investigation into US chipmaker Nvidia
n401e22ec21.summary: China has accused US chipmaker Nvidia of violating its antimonopoly laws, days after Washington announced new export controls. The probe is a regulatory action by Chinese authorities.
n401e22ec21.why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI accelerator chips, and China is an important market for its data-centre products, so regulatory action there affects its revenue outlook.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: The antitrust probe targets Nvidia's operations in China, a significant market for its chips.

n401e22ec21.why_moved: China's antimonopoly investigation follows new US export controls, adding regulatory risk to Nvidia's China business.

nb2f2938cde.headline: Gold (XAUUSD) Goes Bullish
nb2f2938cde.summary: Gold continues a positive trend but stays below the $2,650-2,655 range it has been stuck in for two weeks. Friday's US jobs report boosted expectations of a Federal Reserve rate cut in December.
nb2f2938cde.why: Gold is a traditional store of value that tends to rise when interest rates and Treasury yields fall, which makes it sensitive to Federal Reserve policy expectations.

n0fd8efd5b7.headline: Investment in Power Grid Expansion: A Cost of EUR650 Billion for Germany's Energy Transition
n0fd8efd5b7.summary: Investment in Germany's power grid expansion is estimated to cost EUR650 billion as part of the country's energy transition.
n0fd8efd5b7.why: Grid expansion is required to connect renewable generation to consumers, and its funding drives demand for utilities, equipment and construction.

nb9256b73c4.headline: Bank of Korea governor says won unlikely to return to past levels, Yonhap reports
nb9256b73c4.summary: South Korea's central bank governor said it was difficult for the dollar-won exchange rate to return to levels seen in the past, Yonhap reported.
nb9256b73c4.why: The Bank of Korea is the country's central bank, and the won's exchange rate affects import costs and foreign investor returns.

n9f61abaed4.headline: Property firm tops tax defaulters list, settles for €6.7m
n9f61abaed4.summary: A property development firm topped the latest Revenue tax defaulters list after reaching a €6.7 million settlement with the tax collector.
n9f61abaed4.why: Revenue is Ireland's tax authority, and its defaulters list names firms with outstanding tax liabilities.

n15d8277672.headline: Forging alliances PM’s diplomatic push amid economic turmoil
n15d8277672.summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif visited Riyadh, his fifth meeting with Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman in six months. The trip comes amid economic turmoil in Pakistan.
n15d8277672.why: Saudi Arabia is a major financial partner for Pakistan, and its support can affect Pakistan's external financing.

ne5526308ab.headline: KSE-100 nears 110,000-point mark
ne5526308ab.summary: The Pakistan Stock Exchange extended its bullish run to a ninth consecutive session on Monday, with the KSE-100 gaining 916.43 points.
ne5526308ab.why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index of the Pakistan Stock Exchange, tracking the country's largest listed companies.
ne5526308ab.why_moved: Shares gained 916.43 points on Monday, extending a ninth consecutive session of bullish momentum on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.

n891de23ab5.headline: Pakistan emerging from serious economic challenges: US envoy
n891de23ab5.summary: The US Chargé d'Affaires in Islamabad said Pakistan is emerging from serious economic challenges.
n891de23ab5.why: Assessments from major partners such as the United States can influence investor confidence in Pakistan's economic recovery.

ned554ea4cb.headline: Thailand Requires Strategic Reforms to Accelerate Economic Growth
ned554ea4cb.summary: Thailand's economy is recovering on stronger private demand and tourism, but faces risks from weak exports and high debt. Structural reforms are needed.
ned554ea4cb.why: Thailand is a major Southeast Asian economy, and its growth drivers and debt levels affect regional trade and investment.

n79503e84df.headline: ALI raises P2.8 billion from block sale of AREIT shares
n79503e84df.summary: Property developer Ayala Land Inc. has raised P2.8 billion through another round of block sale of AREIT Inc. shares.
n79503e84df.why: Ayala Land is one of the Philippines' largest property developers, and AREIT is a listed real estate investment trust it has partly held.

ne3b652068c.headline: Nissan suffers another blow: Luxury brand Infiniti to ax US dealerships
ne3b652068c.summary: Nissan is set to axe a number of showrooms under its luxury division, Infiniti, adding to its recent difficulties.
ne3b652068c.why: Nissan is a major Japanese automaker, and its Infiniti brand sells premium vehicles through dealer networks, mainly in the United States.

nbfb36269c7.headline: PLDT keen on keeping lead in data center capacity
nbfb36269c7.summary: Telco PLDT Inc. plans to keep its market dominance in data centers by building more facilities, mostly in Southern Tagalog, with capacities of at least 100 megawatts.
nbfb36269c7.why: PLDT is the Philippines' largest telecom group, and its data center business supports cloud and AI demand across the region.

n10d0cece2b.headline: Canada Post strike on day 26 as union sends new proposals
n10d0cece2b.summary: The Canada Post strike is nearing four weeks with no end in sight, after the Canadian Union of Postal Workers sent new proposals including wage gains and job protections.
n10d0cece2b.why: Canada Post is the national postal operator, and prolonged labour disputes affect parcel delivery, e-commerce logistics and public-sector costs.

n5228c4810b.headline: Freeland won’t say if deficit set to rise but will meet debt-to-GDP anchor - National | Globalnews.ca
n5228c4810b.summary: Finance Minister Chrystia Freeland said Ottawa's balance sheet remains on a sustainable track but did not say whether the deficit would rise, while affirming the debt-to-GDP anchor.
n5228c4810b.why: The federal deficit and debt-to-GDP target shape Canada's fiscal policy, government bond issuance and sovereign credit assessments.
